Fun Facts

  • This station is the second Floating Station to be built, with the first Floating Station being East Margin Station.
  • This station is the first and currently the only station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division to '''NOT''' feature any exits. However, it should be noted that there is a real-life Station in Japan that does not feature any exits.
  • This station is chosen as the venue for the Project Nazca fifth anniversary station.
  • This station is the first of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a friend of the Railway Builder, with the other two stations being Kelper Mount Station and Newmonth River Station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8OS5zSj4FYQ&list=PLNhYxUePw7Tg1rREE0edT43DiwcPpj_Ax&t=1942s</ref>
  • This station caused to have all available Station Types at the time of its construction (Elevated, Ground, Underground, Island, Pseudoground, Floating).
  • The unheightened Basic Platform Gates of this station, as well as the east-facing platforms, is designed for passengers to look at the sunrise.

History

  • June 15 2017: The structure of this station is complete.https://www.facebook.com/nazcarailway/photos/a.568042613315465/1299865560133163/</ref>
  • June 17 2017: This station began services.
